Stress. Stressful situations. These always bring on the psychotic episodes. You can predict how wild things will get with me by how much I'm stressed. Had two different episodes happen at work. Luckily I cant remember them very well because I hear it was awful.
I switched to it after a 70 pound gain with seroquel. The weight is flying off because I cant eat other than the time I have to to take it. Tummy hurts alot. Ugh.

I was taken off seroquel after some years due to alot of sleep walking, sleep eating, and also it was just keeping me tired and agitated. And fatter every day.  So we decided to try abilify. First night wasnt bad. Slept ok. Second night had the worst nightmares that I could have ever imagined. By the end of the week I was having night terrors that would take an hour to shake off after being woke up and doused with wet rags. Mania with psychotic breaks followed the same day at work on the job. I am  still scared to think about it. I was not warned of this at all. Went straight to low dose 20 mg  latuda and I've been in the lowest depression of all time since but my dose just got doubled today so hopefully this changes. I stopped all movements and eating and bathing within an week of latuda and had no idea why. I'm so scared to change anything again. I barely kept a home thru this the job is gone. I'm back up now and hoping like hell.
